semantics.SUCCESS: Observable episode evidence establishes completion of the assigned browser task.
semantics.FAILURE: Observable episode evidence establishes that the assigned browser task was not completed.
semantics.UNDETERMINABLE: Available artifacts are insufficient to establish either success or failure; success must not be inferred.

semantics.SUCCESSFUL_RECOVERY: An executed recovery resolved the observed failure and the post-recovery evidence shows restored progress.
semantics.FAILED_RECOVERY: A recovery was executed but did not resolve the observed failure within the registered recovery window.
semantics.NO_RECOVERY_ATTEMPT: The reviewed episode contains no executed recovery attempt.
semantics.UNDETERMINABLE: The artifacts do not support a reliable recovery-outcome decision.

semantics.MEMORY_HELP: Paired causal evidence attributes a better E3 outcome to an admitted frozen-memory intervention.
semantics.MEMORY_HARM: Paired causal evidence attributes a worse E3 outcome to an admitted frozen-memory intervention.
semantics.NO_DEMONSTRABLE_MEMORY_EFFECT: The paired evidence does not demonstrate either help or harm from frozen memory.
semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: The reviewed evidence has no admitted frozen-memory intervention suitable for an E2/E3 effect judgment.
semantics.UNDETERMINABLE: A memory-effect judgment is applicable but the available paired artifacts are insufficient.

semantics.NO_FAILURE_OBSERVED: No failure is supported by the reviewed observable evidence.
semantics.BBOX_OR_PARAMETER_FAILURE: The primary supported failure is target grounding or concrete action-parameter resolution.
semantics.LOOP_FAILURE: The primary supported failure is repeated non-progressing agent behavior.
semantics.OTHER_AGENT_FAILURE: The primary supported failure is agent-caused but is neither bbox/parameter failure nor a loop.
semantics.ENVIRONMENT_OR_INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE: The primary supported failure is external to the agent policy or recovery mechanism.
semantics.MIXED_FAILURE: Agent and environment causes are both materially supported and cannot be separated as the primary cause.
semantics.UNDETERMINABLE: The available artifacts do not support a reliable primary failure attribution.

semantics.JUSTIFIED_INTERVENTION: An intervention was executed in response to observable failure or non-progress evidence.
semantics.UNNECESSARY_INTERVENTION: An intervention was executed without observable evidence that it was needed.
semantics.NO_INTERVENTION: The reviewed episode contains no recovery or memory intervention.
semantics.UNDETERMINABLE: The artifacts are insufficient to judge whether an executed intervention was necessary.

strata.name: ordinary_success
strata.selection: lowest deterministic hash among eligible episodes

strata.name: terminal_failure
strata.selection: lowest deterministic hash among eligible episodes

strata.name: recovery
strata.selection: lowest deterministic hash among eligible episodes

strata.name: e2_e3_disagreement
strata.selection: lowest deterministic hash where available; record shortfall without substitution

category_coverage_rule: report selected and eligible counts; unavailable cases remain explicit and are never fabricated or substituted
